messages:
jason: quick heads-up — we need a concise compatibility matrix for variant fallbacks across tiers/regions. thinking tokenizer + ctx length + tool-calling parity as primary axes. anyone opposed?
maria: +1. do we have a current source-of-truth? i only find a bunch of spreadsheets in eng drive.
eli: i updated a google sheet last week — but it's messy and model-by-model. can we standardize to three tokenizer families: bpe, byte-level, sentencepiece?
priya: important: some quantized variants drop tool-calls due to missing function signature annotations. seen this with quant-8bit-v2 vs base-v1.
jason: exact. matrix rows = model variants, cols = tokenizer/context/tool-calls/cost_impact, and cells should be short flags e.g., Y/N/deg/emul.
sophie: +1. also include max context and effective context after kv-cache truncation — those differ across variants.
maria: for region routing: fallback should prefer same tokenizer first even if slightly higher latency. decoder mismatch is a silent failure mode.
jason: proposing a canonical cell format: "tok:TYPE;ctx:XXXX;tool:Y|N|emul;cost:low|med|high;notes:short". sample?
eli: sample snippet: 
```
gptx-base-v1: tok:bpe; ctx:8192; tool:Y; cost:med; notes:kv-ok
gptx-quant8-v1: tok:bpe; ctx:6144; tool:emul; cost:low; notes:tools via shim (latency +20%)
alpaca-sp-v2: tok:sp; ctx:4096; tool:N; cost:low; notes:tooling not supported
```
priya: shim emulation exists but often breaks typed args. need a focused test harness for function round-trip.
devops-bot: @channel rollout-candidate deployed to staging for canary checks — run matrix tests with tag `fallback-matrix-2026-03-18`.
jason: thanks. can someone author the test harness? should auto-run: tokenizer mismatch prompts, tool-call round trips, context edgecases (boundary + kv-truncation).
eli: i'll spin up tokenizer + tool-call junit. priya — can you own quantized variants + emulation tests?
priya: yep. also suggest adding scoreboard metrics: percent_of_requests_requiring_emulation and median_latency_delta.
sophie: ux note for Console: show a "compatibility signal" per route (green/yellow/red) with hover details linking to matrix cells and cost impact.
maria: quotas note: if region fallback crosses billing tier, surface to quota engine — rate limits/costs can change. annotate matrix with a cost_impact flag.
jason: good call. add col `cost` with low/med/high.
eli: timeline? need initial PR & test harness by friday to include in next sprint.
jason: aim for friday draft. ping me in-thread with links. :thumbsup:
